Container.Name: homebox-agent
Container.Overview: Household inventory agent: claude-hermes on Discord with only Homebox tools. Security level strict, no SSH keys, no shell, web or file-writing tools. Source: https://github.com/benfugate/homebox-agent
Container.Requires: A Claude Code subscription. After first start, open a container terminal and run: claude, then /login

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Claude Code login, hermes settings (Discord token and IDs in hermes/settings.json), state and logs.

Config.Name: HOMEBOX_URL
Config.Description: Homebox base URL as reachable from this container, e.g. http://192.0.2.10:3100

Config.Name: IS_SANDBOX
Config.Description: Lets Claude Code accept --dangerously-skip-permissions as root. Required.
